title: Karuwa – A traditional Nepali water vessel made of brass or bronze. It has a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a long curved spout and is commonly used in Nepali households to serve drinking water. It’s also used during rituals, puja and cultural ceremonies. Now a days, many people keep it as a decorative or symbolic item.
